opportunities.title: Conference Attendance Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full and Fellow members. Postgraduate, Full and Fellow applicants must be submitting/presenting an abstract at the meeting they wish to attend. Conference Attendance Awards can only be used to attend Society meetings (all categories) and Society-sponsored meetings (Postgraduate, Full and Fellow Members).
opportunities.summary: Funding to attend a Society and/or Society-sponsored conference. Covers registration for the conference(s) applied for and attendance at meeting dinner(s), plus a contribution toward advanced standard travel and accommodation up to the total value of the award on presentation of receipts. Members can apply to attend up to three meetings with one application.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members of The Physiological Society. The applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: To support members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research that addresses a key question in physiological education. Funds must be used within 12 months of the grant award date.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members of The Physiological Society. The applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: To support members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or to finalise a project, as well as supporting activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact. Applications should be physiological in nature. Funds must be used within 12 months of the grant award date.

opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events. Funding cannot be used to support salary costs, to attend conferences or to fund membership payments.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who are members of The Physiological Society.
opportunities.summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who require additional support to help them achieve their full potential. Funds should be used within 12 months of the date of receipt. Funds cannot be used to pay for staff salaries but may be used for consumables, registration for Higher Education Academy Fellowship or other sundries that can be fully justified.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full members or Fellows of the Physiological Society in their second year of membership, or longer.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for Members to run activities that address the principles of Equity, Diversity and Inclusion. Intended for projects that directly investigate or address inclusion and diversity issues in the physiological sciences in either teaching or research. Funds must be used within 6 months of the award date.
